# @arki/db

> Drizzle ORM helpers for ARKI: Postgres and PGlite runtimes, branded ids, feature-owned schema, repositories for Dot features, and serializable transactional procedures for oRPC.

## Import paths
- `@arki/db` / `@arki/db/init`: `createDb`, `initDb`. Imports node-postgres; server only.
- `@arki/db/dot`: the Dot plugins `db()`, `dbMigrations()`, `repos()`, `reader()`, `advisoryLocks()`.
- `@arki/db/transaction`: `runTransaction`, `retryableSqlState`, `DbTransactionError`, `isDbTransactionError`, `DB_TRANSACTION_ERROR_CODES`. Portable.
- `@arki/db/orpc`: `transactionalProcedure`, `transactionalProcedureConfig`, `TransactionScopeOf`, `TransactionContext`. Portable; optional peer `@orpc/server`.
- `@arki/db/eslint`: the rule `db/no-effects-in-transaction`. Tooling only; needs typed linting.
- `@arki/db/id`, `@arki/db/id-factory`, `@arki/db/temporal`, `@arki/db/pagination`, `@arki/db/orm`, `@arki/db/pg`, `@arki/db/runtime-local`: see the README.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): usage, Dot features, transactional procedures.
- [Agent guide](docs/agent-guide.md): transactions in depth. File map, decision table, the SQLSTATE allowlist, the error codes, words easy to mix up.

- [Retry outside oRPC (jobs, scripts)](README.md#serializable-retry-outside-orpc-runtransaction)

## Files
- `src/transaction.ts`: settings, `runTransaction`, the SQLSTATE classifier, `DbTransactionError`.
- `src/orpc.ts`: the middleware, its pipeline checks, `transactionalProcedureConfig`.
- `src/eslint.ts`: the lint rule.
- `src/composition.ts`: `TransactionalDb`, `createUnitOfWork`, `composeSchema`.
- `src/dot.ts`: the Dot plugins, `Repos<F>`, `RepoSet<F>`.

## Rules that bite
- `transact` is the last `.use()` of the procedure. Anything after it reruns on every retry (`ARKI_DB_TX_E004`).
- `implement(contract, transactionalProcedureConfig)`, or output is validated after the commit (`ARKI_DB_TX_E004`).
- No `fetch`, queue writes or `.effect()` inside transactional code: they run once per attempt and do not roll back.
- Only `40001` and `40P01` are retried. A lost connection around `COMMIT` is never retried; recover with an idempotency key and a journal receipt.
- PGlite never conflicts (one connection). Prove retry behaviour on real PostgreSQL.
- In a Dot feature, rename the pool-bound repos source to `repositories`; the bound set is `repos`.
